D3.role: independent designer D3 (systems and cost first), WL98 design-only batch
D3.summary:
Systems-first analysis of where an edit's cost goes, built from recorded component times (WL97 E5 / D, WL96A; scratch model in experiments/wl98_calc/D3/cost_model.py, output in results/wl98_calc/D3/cost_model.json).

Where the time goes:
- On GM1 / CK2 (N 1,270), 69-81 % of every lifecycle is CPU-side overhead [MEAS E5].
- Transport work in GPU-kernel ms: frame 22.7, relation update about 4.5, q table 1.84, one explicit order 0.53 [MEAS].
- The frame is identical for ECRO and EXP (LOW prefix + table lookup) [MEAS WL87].

Role-specific Amdahl ceilings [ARITH]:
- Resolvent-only: 1.02-1.16.
- Full ECRO-type operator with factors resident: 1.11-1.20 for edit -> frame; up to 4.2 for source -> table.
- Full operator with a per-edit generator (rule reuse): 0.91-0.97 on the kernel basis; 1.15-1.29 only on the overhead-dominated wall basis.
- The ECRO generator builds a dense N x N form-factor matrix (model86.py:83-89), i.e. O(N^2): 38 GB at N 1e5.

Ownership finding [PRED]:
- In the planar / convex scene86 / GM1 family, a learned representation reused across a rigid edit can only re-learn ER (BRDF compression) or learn dynamic inter-body C (WL52 class).
- Rigid-invariant non-local transport is identically absent there. CK2 can attribute H1 / H2 for ECRO but cannot carry a positive H3.
- The amortisable rigid-invariant lever exists only in non-convex rigid bodies' self-transport (iterated glossy, alpha^-2 angular cost per order, recomputed whenever the incident field changes) and, secondarily, in static-environment transport between edits.

Candidates:
- Primary: RB-DTO. One shared model compiles a passive, measure-valued, body-local non-local self-transport operator per rigid body, with learned continuous sharp lobes plus a path-tag-split broad channel. The first event stays exact ER, inter-body C stays explicit and current, and a self-path-region certificate controls validity with explicit fallback.
- Independent alternative: LER-Delta. A frozen learned environment resolvent plus explicit sparse edit-delta iteration.
- Rejected:
  - A, the ECRO-lineage continuous kernel: its per-patch factors depend on current visibility through message passing, and it has no edit headroom.
  - B, learned multiresolution angular tables: the learning-free twin dominates; kept as an H2 control.
  - C at patch level: equals ER compression.
  - Online NRC (retrains) and learned inter-body C.

Falsification plan:
- A learning-free Stage 0 cost-anatomy gate runs before any training.
- Track G (GM1 / CK2, shared data, budget and reference) does H1 / H2 attribution.
- Track B (a new admitted rigid-body family: W-graze, W-broad, independent W-held, T0 -> T1 rigid edits, a certificate-violation control, fixed weights) tests the candidate and H3.
- The plan includes oracle-floor vs binned-control and learned-arm stages, paired statistics, at least 3 seeds and at least 16 draws, and contract tests alongside the real-scene evaluation.

Verdict: DESIGN_READY_FOR_HUMAN_REVIEW, conditional on human decisions D1 / D2. If either is rejected, the verdict becomes NO_DEFENSIBLE_CANDIDATE for the current workload family.

candidates.name: RB-DTO: Rigid-Body Directional Transfer Operator
candidates.learned_physical_meaning: Non-local part N_b = (I - K_b C_self,b)^-1 K_b - K_b of a rigid body's response: radiance leaving the body after >= 1 self-hit through its own certified air pockets. Linear, non-negative, passive, source- and scene-independent, intrinsic to the body's geometry and ER materials under a self-path certificate. The first local event remains exact frozen ER.
candidates.io: Compile once per rigid asset: body mesh / patch tokens in the body frame (position, normal, tangent, area, ER descriptor) -> per-patch latents, via sparse (k-NN / self-visibility graph) attention; no dense N^2. Apply per coupled-solve iteration: incident samples (x_i, omega_i, Phi_i) in the body frame from explicit C_ext / source projection -> (a) K_s sharp exit lobes per sample (exit point / direction mean, anisotropic width, weight) and (b) a low-rank broad per-patch code. These are reduced into a per-patch output cache. Queries from C_ext rays and the camera LOW second vertex are made at exact continuous (x, omega).
candidates.ownership: ER owns first local events. N_b owns all segments inside the body's certified self-path region (C_self). Explicit current C_ext = C - C_self owns all inter-body and escaping segments. One owner per segment, verified by a path-tag identity test. This is a refinement of the FNTO object-identity rule and requires [HUM] D1.
candidates.energy_contract: Measure: radiant flux per incident sample. Exact budget B = Phi_i * [rho_ER(omega_i) - E_esc(x_i, omega_i)], with E_esc from cached self-visibility. The network outputs a simplex over {sharp lobes, broad channel, absorbed/null}. Lobes are probability densities on area x projected solid angle. Row-wise passivity holds by construction, so the composed spectral radius with sub-stochastic C_ext is < 1. Reciprocity is measured, not built in.
candidates.sharp_mechanism: Continuous lobes whose position and width are predicted per incident sample (no bin grid, no grazing-bin bias). Exit measures are predicted directly, so there is no receiver-side single-draw variance inside the body. Dirac / ballistic pass-through is outside N_b by definition and handled by C_ext ray tracing; the ER family has no Dirac lobe.
candidates.learned_vs_explicit_value: Over per-update explicit intra-body sweeps (J_int * N_b * K_int, K_int ~ alpha^-2 for iterated glossy): a converged zero-variance response at apply cost independent of J_int and K_int. Over an explicitly precomputed sparse binned per-body transfer (0.17-2.7 GB per 200-patch asset at alpha 0.03 [ARITH]): continuous peaks and widths, MB-scale memory, and one shared model that compiles unseen assets without per-asset path tracing. No value for convex bodies, mirror chains or broad few-bounce bodies. The value is a prediction, gated by Stage 0 / 1.
candidates.failure_conditions: Stage 0 Amdahl ceiling of explicit intra-body work below U_min. Oracle floor fails grazing internal incidence (H2). Shared model fails held-out bodies while a per-asset fit passes. Frequent certificate violations (contact, objects entering cavities, environment-as-body). Self-shadow / transition blur (WL52 P2 analogue). Frame query overhead cancels the gain. Reciprocity or composed energy fails. Prior-art equivalence (PRT family) [HUM D9].
candidates.complexity: Compile O(N_b * k * d^2) once per asset, off the edit path. Apply O(M_in * (t_query + K_s * t_reduce)) + O(M_in * R + N_b * R * n_basis) per outer iteration. Query O(M_p) lobes per C_ext / camera query. Memory: shared weights + N_b * d latents + cache, about 0.3 MB per 400-patch body (vs GB-scale for the explicit precomputed twin).
candidates.rigid_reuse: Exact equivariance: incident samples mapped by T^-1, outputs by T. Compiled latents are reused for moved and stationary bodies. No retraining and no per-edit compiler inference. Invalidated only by non-rigid / material edits or certificate failure.
candidates.visibility_interface: Inter-body visibility is explicit and current (selective dirty-ray update on C_ext only). Self-visibility is static in the body frame (cached or inside N_b) and is not dynamic. A self-path-region certificate is tested against moved primitives per edit; on violation the body falls back to explicit, with that fallback measured. No dynamic visibility is coupled into the intrinsic representation.
candidates.training_target: Frozen-ER path-traced exit samples of procedurally generated non-convex rigid bodies (grooves, brackets, cups, open boxes, corner reflectors, multi-part assemblies). Incident samples are stratified with an explicit grazing-ring share. Exits after >= 1 self-hit are path-tagged by lobe class: the sharp channel is supervised by mixture NLL / sliced-Wasserstein, the broad channel by tagged projected flux, and total flux against the exact budget. No scene, lights or M64.
candidates.why_not_brdf_compression: The first event stays exact ER. N_b predicts spatially displaced, multi-event transport determined by the body's global self-visibility, which no BRDF contains. Contract test: N_b is identically zero for convex bodies.
candidates.rationale: It is the only learned role found that is non-local, rigid-invariant under an explicit certificate, and that replaces explicit work scaling with angular sharpness and bounce count without per-edit regeneration. It keeps C dynamic and explicit and ER exact, as one shared model. It does not address GM1 / CK2 inter-body panel -> box delivery, which by ownership is dynamic C.

candidates.name: LER-Delta: Learned Environment Resolvent with explicit edit-delta iteration
candidates.family: other (all-order environment resolvent, continuous lobe + broad decoder)
candidates.learned_physical_meaning: All-order (>= 2 event) directional resolvent H_E = sum_{j>=1} T_E^j of the static environment at its reference configuration (movable objects removed). Linear, non-negative, passive, source-independent and environment-specific.
candidates.io: Incident field samples at environment patches (from sources and from Delta-transport) -> environment outgoing >= 2-event radiance at continuous (x, omega). Edits enter through explicit sparse (M - B): B are environment paths blocked by movable objects (from the dirty relation rays), M are paths involving movable objects.
candidates.ownership: H_E owns environment-only paths. B is an exact explicit negative correction for paths H_E wrongly includes after the edit. M is explicit (movable bodies' self-transport may use RB-DTO). One owner per path, verified by path tags.
candidates.energy_contract: H_E is passive by the same per-sample flux simplex budget. The Delta-iteration b = (I + H_E)[e + (M - B) b] converges only if rho(H_E (M - B)) < 1. Iteration count and residual are reported, no clamping, and the update falls back to explicit if it does not converge in the declared count.
candidates.sharp_mechanism: Continuous learned lobes for the environment's own sharp self-reflections. Sharp content of B (an occluder blocking a beam) is explicit through the dirty rays.
candidates.learned_vs_explicit_value: Replaces J full-relation re-sweeps per edit with I_Delta learned applies plus sparse Delta work. Learning buys a compact all-order sharp resolvent. The learning-free twin (explicit precomputed resolvent) is infeasible for sharp content (81k x 81k per channel on GM1) and fails at low rank.
candidates.failure_conditions: Small N or broad materials (explicit sweeps cheap: 4 x 0.53 ms kernel on GM1). Large occluders (rho near 1, many iterations). WL41 / 44-type out-of-span fidelity of H_E on Delta-fields. Per-environment learned state out of scope [HUM D4]. Dirty-ray variance of the sharp B content.
candidates.complexity: Per edit: I_Delta * (sparse explicit over dirty/new rays + H_E apply ~ O(M_in * t_query)). Compile or fit once per environment, offline.
candidates.rigid_reuse: H_E is fixed across all edits of movable objects. Only B and M (explicit, current) change.
candidates.visibility_interface: All dynamic visibility enters through explicit B and M. H_E contains only static environment visibility.
candidates.training_target: Frozen-ER path-traced >= 2-event exit / landing samples from stratified incident samples on environment patches, including grazing strata.
candidates.why_not_brdf_compression: H_E is an all-order, multi-event, environment-wide non-local operator.
candidates.rationale: Independent of RB-DTO in what is learned (environment vs body) and in how edits enter (Delta-iteration vs certificate). It is the only design found that amortises multi-bounce work across edits where the static environment carries the transport. It is admissible only if the owner allows per-environment learned state, and only after Stage 0 shows that full-relation re-sweeps are a large share of the edit lifecycle at the target N and alpha.

candidates.name: A: continuous directional learned kernel (ECRO lineage, patch level)
candidates.learned_physical_meaning: A geometry-conditioned patch operator: direct incident irradiance (continuous direction) -> >= 2-event outgoing radiance (continuous direction), via a single learned flight through exact-direction state rays plus a low-rank global term.
candidates.io: Source encoding at exact incident direction. Per-patch latents with an angular MLP decoder, queried at exact outgoing direction per state ray and camera query.
candidates.ownership: A learned K-C composite owning >= 2-event paths including free-space segments, regenerated per edit.
candidates.energy_contract: Softplus factors, no passivity. ECRO's local factor rows are already non-passive (E1). A simplex budget could be added; the composed measure is undefined today.
candidates.sharp_mechanism: A continuous sender decoder. Delivery still uses receiver-uniform state rays, so single-draw variance remains (J3).
candidates.learned_vs_explicit_value: The sender half equals ER (exact, compact). The flight is explicit. The global half is the WL96A resolvent role. Per-edit ceilings with the generator are 0.91-0.97 (kernel basis) and <= 1.29 (overhead-dominated wall) on GM1.
candidates.failure_conditions: Dynamic visibility implicitly coupled into per-patch c/a factors via Ft message passing and openness (model86.py:91-104). Does not substantially replace explicit transport on edits. Sharp response needs the explicit flight. O(N^2) generator.
candidates.complexity: Generator O(N^2) dense form-factor message passing (6 MB at 1,270; 38 GB at 1e5) + per-state-ray decoder evaluations (650k MLP evaluations per flight).
candidates.rigid_reuse: Weights only; factors regenerated every edit.
candidates.visibility_interface: Current state rays are an explicit input, but visibility also enters the supposedly local response factors.
candidates.training_target: Path-traced 2-5-event fields (never M64), with grazing-balanced coverage.
candidates.why_not_brdf_compression: Not purely, but its sender half is BRDF compression.
candidates.rationale: Meets three brief unsuitability criteria (visibility coupled into the response factors, no substantial edit replacement, needs the explicit flight). Retained only as the Track G H1 diagnostic arm (existing representation + coverage-balanced retraining).

candidates.name: B: learned sparse multi-resolution angular representation
candidates.learned_physical_meaning: A patch x adaptive-angular-cell table whose refinement pattern and coefficients are predicted by a network from geometry and material.
candidates.io: As the binned table, with variable cells.
candidates.ownership: As EXP / ECRO tables.
candidates.energy_contract: Flux-conserving cell integrals can be exact.
candidates.sharp_mechanism: Refinement at lobes, whose location is analytically known from ER and the incident direction.
candidates.learned_vs_explicit_value: None. The learning-free twin (flux-conserving / 8x32 / adaptive binning) already removes the P2 bias (J2); learning only predicts a cheap index.
candidates.failure_conditions: Dominated by its twin. Learned scoring needs algorithm-only controls first.
candidates.complexity: About that of explicit adaptive tables.
candidates.rigid_reuse: None beyond explicit.
candidates.why_not_brdf_compression: Not BRDF compression; it is learned scoring of an explicit table.
candidates.rationale: Its learning-free version is kept as the mandatory H2 control arm (solid-angle-mean 4x16, flux-conserving 4x16, 8x32, adaptive).

candidates.name: C (patch level): learned directional lobe distribution of patch outgoing radiance
candidates.learned_physical_meaning: Per-patch lobe mixture of outgoing radiance given incident radiance; for planar / convex patches this equals ER applied to the incident field.
candidates.io: Incident lobes -> outgoing lobes per patch.
candidates.ownership: K-local.
candidates.energy_contract: A simplex budget is possible.
candidates.sharp_mechanism: Continuous lobes.
candidates.learned_vs_explicit_value: None: it re-learns ER, which is exact and compact.
candidates.failure_conditions: Reduces to BRDF compression (forbidden by the brief).
candidates.rigid_reuse: Trivial in the material frame.
candidates.why_not_brdf_compression: It is BRDF compression.
candidates.rationale: Family C survives only at body level (RB-DTO), where lobes describe non-local self-transport exits.

D3.falsification_plan:
Hypotheses:
- H1 (coverage / optimisation): same representation, grazing-balanced data, >= 3 seeds. Supported if learned error closes to the representation's oracle floor on the failing stratum.
- H2 (angular representation): oracle floor fitted directly to path-traced targets vs learning-free binned controls at matched memory. Supported if the floor fails and another representation's floor passes.
- H3 (no edit utility): a learning-free Stage 0 Amdahl ceiling of the quality-matched explicit comparator, then measured U at matched T1 quality with fixed weights.

Track G (diagnostic; GM1 / CK2 + E2 + E5 + one new admitted GM1 edit with a T1 reference):
- Arms: G0 frozen ECRO (WL86 + two WL92A OWN checkpoints); G1 ECRO with coverage-balanced retraining (same architecture, >= 3 seeds); G2 learning-free binned controls (solid-angle-mean 4x16, flux-conserving 4x16, 8x32); G3 EXP / C3UR with >= 16 state draws; G4 C3URX1 pooled and deployed-draw.
- G0 / G1 share data, budget and reference; G2-G4 are learning-free.
- CK2 stays diagnostic. M64 is never ground truth.

Track B (candidate; new admitted rigid-body family, admission declared before results):
- Workloads: W-graze (glossy groove / bracket lit at cos < 0.15 into the cavity); W-broad (near-normal, moderate alpha); W-held (unseen body class, light class and edit, never inspected); T0 -> T1 rigid edits plus a near-Omega edit and a certificate-violation control; fixed weights.
- Arms: B0 explicit C3UR-type with cached self-relation and sender-side sampling (quality-cost curve over draws / K); B1 explicit precomputed per-body transfer; B2 RB-DTO oracle floor; B3 / B4 shared model, natural / grazing-balanced coverage; B5 per-asset fit; B6 stale and forced-fallback controls; B7 Native Reuse of an object-level neural asset or UNMEASURED.
- B3-B5 share generator, exit samples and budget. Tracks G and B share only the reference renderer, metrics, statistics and conventions.

Stages:
- Stage 0, cost anatomy (learning-free, mandatory first): A_intra on kernel and wall bases under the declared convention. Stop with NO_HEADROOM if U0 < U_min. Track G also recomputes role ceilings at N 1,270 / 5,080 / 11,430.
- Stage 1, representability (no learning): exit-measure sliced-Wasserstein and fine-histogram L1 per incidence stratum, peak position / width, energy closure, passivity supremum, self-shadow transition sharpness; plus Track G binned controls on one non-grazing light and a second receiver. Stop if the B2 floor fails on W-graze (H2).
- Stage 2, learning: B3 / B4 / B5 with >= 3 seeds. Attribution: H1 if B4 reaches the floor and B3 does not; generalisation / capacity if B5 passes and B4 fails. Stop at the predeclared level.
- Stage 3, coupled T0 -> T1 vs path-traced frozen-ER references: whole image, sharp ROI, changed region and signed change, leakage / ghosting, extra T1 over T0 error, composed rho, path-tag identity, equivariance.
- Stage 4, systems: update critical path, frame including the query overhead, inference, C_ext relation and visibility recompute, certificate, memory, one-off compile / training reported separately, U vs quality-matched B0 interpolated on its quality-cost curve, scaling over bodies, instancing, J_int and alpha.
- Positive claims need two-workload confirmation including W-held.

Statistics:
- Paired designs with identical reference / camera / state draws; >= 3 seeds; >= 16 draws with the deployed-draw distribution reported.
- Reference noise from replica halves; paired block-bootstrap SE (never an L1 noise floor as a paired tolerance).

Synthetic contract tests precede Stage 1: zero / superposition / non-negativity, row passivity, composed rho, exact rigid equivariance, convex body -> zero, analytic V-groove chain, Lambert cavity vs radiosity, furnace, certificate invalidation, path-tag disjointness.

Every numeric threshold is a human decision.
human_decisions: D1 Ownership refinement: may a rigid body's free-space self-paths (C_self) be represented inside a learned body operator under a self-path-region exclusivity certificate with explicit fallback, while inter-body C stays explicit and current?

D2 Scope: accept that the learned component targets rigid-invariant transport (intra-body, environment) while sharp delivery between separately moving bodies stays explicit C by ownership. This is not the excluded 'sharp to explicit + learned residual' default. If rejected, D3 finds no defensible candidate on the current workload family.
D3 Utility threshold U_min and lifecycle convention: wall vs engineered kernel basis, de-overheaded explicit comparator, frame inclusion / resolution / spp, which events count.
D4 Shared vs per-asset / per-environment learned state (method or control only). This also fixes whether an object-level neural asset is a Native Reuse comparator, and whether LER-Delta is in scope.

D5 All numerical gates: peak position / width limits, exit-measure distances per stratum, energy-closure and reciprocity tolerances, E_H thresholds, ROI minimum meaningful effect, leakage limit, extra T1 error, Stage 2 stop level.
D6 Seeds (>= 3 proposed), state-draw budgets (>= 16) and the compute budget.
D7 Track B workload admission values (self-transport share s_min, grazing share g_min, body classes, held-out class, edits).
D8 Whether Track G Stage 2 (ECRO H1 retraining) should run, given its predicted nil H3 content for geometry edits at GM1 scale.

D9 Novelty / prior-art review (PRT Sloan 2002, Ng 2003, shadow fields Zhou 2005, PRTF Pan 2007, modular radiance transfer Loos 2011, neural PRT; recalled, unverified). Compression alone is not novelty.
D10 External comparators: measure Native Reuse of an object-level 8DNA / RNA-type asset or report UNMEASURED. Neural Full Recompute applies only if that asset is actually invalidated.
D11 Batch classification of any Track B execution under the worklog numbering policy.
D3.verdict_rationale:
A primary candidate (RB-DTO) and an independent alternative (LER-Delta) have complete physical, ownership, energy, sharp-mechanism, training, complexity, reuse and visibility contracts. Each states what learning buys over its best learning-free twin and where it fails. The falsification plan separates H1 / H2 / H3, puts a learning-free cost-anatomy gate before any training, keeps diagnostic Track G separate from candidate Track B, and leaves every unsupported number to the owner.

The design is conditional on two ownership / scope decisions (D1, D2). For the current scene86 / GM1 / CK2 family, the systems analysis finds no defensible learned candidate with geometry-edit utility. The reasons [ARITH / PRED from recorded components]:
- Planar / convex objects leave nothing rigid-invariant and non-local to amortise.
- Rule-reuse generators cost at least the explicit transport they replace on the kernel basis.
- The ECRO generator is O(N^2).

So if D1 or D2 is rejected, the verdict becomes NO_DEFENSIBLE_CANDIDATE, scoped to that family and the current FNTO ownership text. Nothing is adopted or approved.
stop_conditions_triggered: Scope finding: a positive H3 test is impossible on the current scene86 / GM1 / CK2 workload family under engineered conventions (no rigid-invariant non-local transport; generator cost >= replaced explicit work on the kernel basis). This is [ARITH / PRED], to be confirmed by the learning-free Stage 0.

D1.role: D1 independent designer — physics and measure first

candidates.name: XQT — exact-sample quadrature transport
candidates.learned_physical_meaning: A learned quadrature rule for each free-space flight. Each relation ray carries a flux quantum phi_r = s_r * proj-measure weight * A_receiver, where s_r is ER evaluated exactly at the exact hit point and direction. A sparse, non-negative, column-stochastic W_theta(G) splits each quantum among visibility-consistent neighbouring receiver cells. The re-projection geometry is exact; only the weights are learned. The weights encode footprint shape, edge preservation and smoothness, not material response and not visibility.
candidates.io: Inputs: relation records per ray (hit-element material descriptor, hit point in the hit frame, direction in both frames, distance, cosines), receiver descriptors and neighbour offsets in the receiver frame. The weights never take radiance values. Output: sparse W, cached as transport coefficients. Per flight: Phi_in = W phi on flux-exact projected-disk incident cells. Pointwise exact-ER emission for non-Lambert senders.
candidates.ownership: Nonlocal only: owns every table-level flight (orders 1..J). Local scattering is frozen ER. The camera prefix stays explicit as in ECRO.
candidates.energy_contract: Per-quantum flux conservation (column sums 1, softmax), non-negative, ER albedo <= 1, flight closure <= 1, so every flight+scatter step has flux norm < 1 and iteration converges. Linear in source by construction. Reciprocity is measured, not imposed.
candidates.sharp_mechanism: No angular approximation: ER is evaluated exactly per ray. The spatially distributed sharp delivery (glint footprints, footprint edges) is carried by learned anisotropic, edge-aware pooling of sparse lobe hits across receivers that see the same sender region, masked by explicit visibility consistency.
candidates.learned_vs_explicit_value: The twin is the same masked flux-conserving redistribution with an analytic kernel. Learning buys only kernel adaptivity (anisotropy, footprint shape, edge decisions). In the flatland scratch, pooling gives 8–50x ray-equivalent over the unpooled exact gather, but an exact-field oracle beats the fixed twin by only 1.0–1.33x in error. If S1-c reproduces this, XQT is an explicit estimator with a learned name and must stop.
candidates.rationale: The only kept design that is information-sufficient by construction (it invents no hits), measure-exact, passive, linear, rigid-invariant and visibility-explicit. It directly targets the measured residual of the exact-sample route: unbiased in expectation, heavy-tailed per draw (P0-3). Its admissibility as 'learned transport' is human decision HD-1. Its prior is weak.
candidates.complexity: Relation N*K rays (650k at N=1,270, K=512). Exact samples N*K ER evaluations per flight (times lights for direct light). W nnz ~ N*K*n_nb (about 5.9M weights, about 24 MB at n_nb=9). Generation: one small MLP per (ray, neighbour), selective after edits. Apply: one sparse product per flight.
candidates.failure_conditions: Visibility structure finer than the neighbourhood sampling (contacts, thin occluders). Fewer than one expected pooled hit per footprint (very small alpha or small, far senders; the CK2 glint gives 0.46 rays per patch per draw). Curved receivers or senders (sphere). A moving sharp sender (all of its records dirty). Distribution shift in alpha or grazing. Overhead/frame-dominated lifecycles (Amdahl).
candidates.visibility_interface: Explicit relation built and selectively updated as in ECRO/C3UR. Redistribution is masked by an explicit visibility-consistency check on each receiver's own records. W never predicts a hit.
candidates.rigid_reuse: Inputs are local or relative only, so W is exactly invariant under global rigid motion. After a rigid edit, W entries with bit-identical receptive-field records are reused (dependency certificate, testable as selective = full); weights are never retrained.
candidates.training_target: The expected per-receiver-cell flux of each flight, from a deterministic exact-ER sender-area quadrature with fine visibility. This is the A-04/E3 oracle class, which matched path-traced CK2 e2_p. It is noise-free and validated against path tracing on a subset; M64 is never used. Data come from a frozen generator stratified by incidence (grazing share at least the test share), alpha, distance and edges inside footprints. All evaluation workloads are excluded with margins.
candidates.why_not_brdf_compression: ER is used verbatim. W contains no material response, only spatial/angular redistribution of already-exact flux.

candidates.name: LLT — learned lobe transfer from sparse probes
candidates.learned_physical_meaning: The lobe form factor: the fraction Q_theta(r) of the exact ER exitant flux of one sender lobe (node x, exact incident direction) that reaches each candidate receiver (softmax plus a miss class), and a normalized footprint density p_theta over position and incoming direction within r.
candidates.io: Inputs: sender node frame, exact ER lobe descriptor, explicit candidate receivers (cone query or coarse sender relation) with relative pose, and K_p explicit probe rays at stratified lobe quantiles with their hit records. Outputs: Q over candidates plus miss, and a continuous normalized footprint mixture per receiver.
candidates.ownership: First flight out of sharp senders only. All other flights are explicit; LLT is not combined with XQT in the plan.
candidates.energy_contract: Sum of Q plus Q_miss = 1, integral of p = 1, and the exitant flux is exact (ER albedo <= 1). Linear per exact incident direction. Not iterated.
candidates.sharp_mechanism: The lobe is exact ER. Where it lands is learned at a resolution not limited by any bin, from the probes plus learned priors on footprint shape and partial visibility.
candidates.learned_vs_explicit_value: The twin traces the same K_p probes as stratified photons with a fixed splat. LLT buys only within-footprint shape and inferred partial visibility; it must reach the twin's error with fewer probes by a declared factor.
candidates.rationale: Independent of XQT in information regime (sparse probes vs full relation), anchoring (sender vs receiver), scope and failure mode. It is the only design that tests learned delivery beyond explicit queries. It is not primary because it must infer unqueried visibility (lever c), costs per light like its explicit twin, and its nearest relative (WL52 learned C) failed at transitions. It runs only if the S1-d information test passes.
candidates.complexity: Per (sender node, incident direction): K_p rays plus |candidates| MLP evaluations; cost scales with nodes times lights. Small per-lobe cache under a certificate.
candidates.failure_conditions: Occluders thinner than the probe spacing, or edges inside the footprint between probes; contacts; curved receivers; many lights; wide lobes with large candidate sets; alpha outside the training range.
candidates.visibility_interface: Explicit probes and candidate queries. Between probes it infers footprint visibility; this is allowed only if the information test passes.
candidates.rigid_reuse: Sender-frame inputs. A lobe's Q/p is reused if its probes and candidate set are unchanged; fixed weights.
candidates.training_target: Deterministic lobe form factors and footprint densities from dense exact-ER quadrature with dense visibility on random geometries, validated against path-traced e2 on a subset.
candidates.why_not_brdf_compression: The lobe is ER; the learned object is its delivery through geometry.

candidates.name: A1 — continuous local directional kernel
candidates.learned_physical_meaning: A neural field k(x, w_i, w_o) for local, possibly spatially varying scattering.
candidates.io: Element-frame position plus incident/outgoing directions to radiance per irradiance.
candidates.ownership: Local K.
candidates.energy_contract: Passivity by penalty or normalized lobes.
candidates.sharp_mechanism: Network capacity.
candidates.learned_vs_explicit_value: None: ER is already the exact, compact, passive, learned local rule.
candidates.rationale: Local BRDF compression, excluded by the brief, with no information gain over ER (as with WL96's E-L+).
candidates.complexity: One network evaluation per query vs one ER evaluation (69 floats per material).
candidates.failure_conditions: Any alpha below the fitted capacity.
candidates.rigid_reuse: Trivial in the material frame.
candidates.why_not_brdf_compression: It is BRDF compression.

candidates.name: A2 — continuous nonlocal learned kernel / learned gather field
candidates.learned_physical_meaning: Incident radiance at (y, w) predicted from sender states and geometry tokens or relation summaries: a learned C.
candidates.io: Continuous receiver position and direction to incident radiance, from geometry or relation context.
candidates.ownership: C.
candidates.energy_contract: No by-construction measure; passivity only by penalty (the WL86–95 failure mode).
candidates.sharp_mechanism: Network capacity in (y, w).
candidates.learned_vs_explicit_value: Amortizes visibility, which the canon gives to explicit queries; otherwise a weaker version of XQT.
candidates.rationale: Either it owns visibility or it is an unnormalized estimator dominated by XQT. Negative prior from WL52 (cost and transitions).
candidates.complexity: Dense network evaluations; WL52 measured 8–60x slower than explicit GPU C.
candidates.failure_conditions: Contacts, visibility transitions.
candidates.rigid_reuse: Possible with relative inputs.
candidates.why_not_brdf_compression: It is nonlocal, but it is learned visibility.

candidates.name: B1 — flux-exact sparse multi-resolution state with a learned resolvent
candidates.learned_physical_meaning: A geometry-conditioned operator for table orders >= 2 on a flux-exact projected-disk quadtree state; the first flight stays explicit.
candidates.io: Sparse coefficients in and out.
candidates.ownership: Learned owns camera events >= 3 behind an explicit first flight.
candidates.energy_contract: Carrier flux-exact; resolvent passivity not by construction.
candidates.sharp_mechanism: Carrier refinement by rule; nothing learned for the sharp first flight.
candidates.learned_vs_explicit_value: Order amortization only. Measured resolvent-only ceiling 1.02/1.04 on CK2, and the explicit e3_o is at reference noise.
candidates.rationale: This is the excluded default (explicit sharp first flight plus learned residual), with a measured null ceiling. The carrier is kept inside XQT.
candidates.failure_conditions: Low higher-order share; cheap explicit sweeps.
candidates.rigid_reuse: Possible with local inputs.
candidates.why_not_brdf_compression: It is a nonlocal resolvent, but only a residual.

candidates.name: C1 — learned sender lobe/distribution representation
candidates.learned_physical_meaning: An encoder mapping the incident state plus ER descriptor to a mixture of outgoing lobes per sharp element.
candidates.io: Incident field to lobe parameters; readout by lobe evaluation.
candidates.ownership: Local K re-expression.
candidates.energy_contract: Flux-exact if lobes are normalized.
candidates.sharp_mechanism: Lobe parameters.
candidates.learned_vs_explicit_value: None for direct light (exact ER at the exact direction); an approximation of an explicit sum for indirect light.
candidates.rationale: Amortized ER fitting, i.e. BRDF compression in a spatial wrapper.
candidates.failure_conditions: Multi-lobe and grazing ER structure.
candidates.rigid_reuse: Material frame.
candidates.why_not_brdf_compression: It is BRDF compression.

candidates.name: E0 — frozen ECRO v0 lineage (control)
candidates.learned_physical_meaning: Geometry-conditioned per-patch rank-16 local factor pair used as sender, receiver and decoder; one learned flight; rank-24 global term.
candidates.io: 64-bin solid-angle irradiance encoding to a 64-bin solid-angle-mean outgoing table.
candidates.ownership: Learned local factors overlap ER's role; flight through explicit state rays; learned global term.
candidates.energy_contract: Linear and non-negative; not passive (worst-row albedo 2.2–3.1); never iterated.
candidates.sharp_mechanism: Rank-16 factors in 64 solid-angle bins.
candidates.learned_vs_explicit_value: Measured worse than or equal to explicit on sharp transport (WL86–WL96A).
candidates.rationale: Kept only as frozen control C0 and as the basis of the H1 arm. It violates rigid invariance (world coordinates and a global mean token as inputs), the measure (solid-angle convention) and identifiability (latent sender).
candidates.complexity: Generator 11 ms per edit; apply about 0.8 ms.
candidates.failure_conditions: Grazing sharp delivery; held-out sharp F2.
candidates.visibility_interface: Explicit state rays plus form-factor message passing.
candidates.rigid_reuse: Weights reused, but every factor depends on the whole scene; no local certificate.
candidates.why_not_brdf_compression: Its local factors partly are a compression of the BRDF.

candidates.name: O1 — asset-level reflectance-field K
candidates.learned_physical_meaning: A learned operator from the incident light field to the outgoing light field on a rigid asset's bounding proxy, including exposed self-interreflection.
candidates.io: 4D to 4D light field in the proxy frame.
candidates.ownership: Puts exposed same-asset free-space paths into K.
candidates.energy_contract: Possible by normalization.
candidates.sharp_mechanism: Network capacity.
candidates.learned_vs_explicit_value: Memory compression of a rigid-invariant operator; genuine state reuse.
candidates.rationale: Contradicts Architecture section 2 (exposed same-asset paths belong to C). It has no content in the planar/convex scene86 family and is close to the external 8DNA class. Considering it is a canon decision (HD-8).
candidates.failure_conditions: Intrusion into the proxy, contact, deformation.
candidates.rigid_reuse: Exact under rigid motion of the asset.
candidates.why_not_brdf_compression: It is nonlocal, but it is outside canon.

D1.falsification_plan:
Hypotheses: H1 (coverage/optimisation), H2 (angular representation), H3 (no edit utility), plus H_X (XQT beats both the unpooled gather and its twin by declared factors) and H_L (LLT's probes are information-sufficient).

Workloads, all admitted by geometry-only rules before any reference:
- W-G (CK2): diagnostic only. Needs a new T1 reference and is excluded from training.
- W-G2: new grazing workload with both glint-core and tail receivers.
- W-N: non-grazing sharp.
- W-H: never-inspected held-out, preferably a WL89 V3-family rigid motion of the sharp sender.
- W-S: synthetic contract fixtures.
- W-X (optional): scale axis in N and number of lights.
All evidence workloads have T0->T1 rigid edits and are evaluated with fixed weights.

Arms:
- C0: frozen ECRO.
- C1 ECRO-COV: same architecture, parameters and steps; grazing-stratified coverage and a physical, non-M64 sender target.
- C1f: flux-exact 64-bin variant.
- R0 floors: 64 solid-angle, 64 flux-exact, 8x32 flux-exact, adaptive projected-disk, exact per-ray.
- X explicit comparators: EXP/C3UR, C3URX1 at 1–16x draws, optional photons/DQ.
- XQT twin and XQT; LLT twin and LLT.
- STALE control.
A sharing matrix separates what shares data, budget, reference and ray budget.

Stages:
- S0: admission plus references (two halves; deterministic-oracle agreement) or STOP.
- S1 (learning-free): S1-a H2 floors per receiver group; S1-b explicit quality–cost frontier over 16 or more paired draws; S1-c XQT twin and an exact-field oracle (STOP if eta or oracle/twin margin is below the declared values); S1-d LLT collision-pair information test (STOP if the floor exceeds tolerance); S1-e zero-cost and quality-matched H3 ceilings (STOP if both are below U_req on two workloads).
- S2: H1 arm.
- S3: candidate training with matched compute and contract tests T1–T10 (STOP on failure).
- S4: held-out T0/T1 with fixed weights, selective = full and STALE.
- S5: uncontended, quality-matched lifecycle economics.

Decision mapping:
- H1 share = e(C0) - e(C1).
- Optimisation residual = e(C1) - R0 floor.
- H2 share = R0(64 solid-angle) - R0(candidate).
- H3 refuted only if fidelity is met, U >= U_req on two evidence workloads and the twin is beaten.
- CK2 can never change a label.

Statistics: common random numbers; at least 3 seeds; draw resampling; two-half references; debiased L2; block bootstrap; paired tolerance max(2 SE, floor). Labels are never decided by a single draw or an L1 noise floor.
human_decisions: HD-1: Is an estimator-type learned operator over explicit visibility samples (XQT) admissible as the project's core learned transport? If not, D1's verdict for the GM1 surface regime becomes NO_DEFENSIBLE_CANDIDATE except for the gated LLT.
HD-2: Which learning-free sharp carriers serve as comparators (C3URX1 draws, photons, deterministic quadrature); canon allows them only as comparators.
HD-3: Numerical thresholds: d_min, s_min, sharp-ROI tolerances, eta_req, oracle/twin margin m_req, U_req (historical 1.25 or other), tau_floor, number of seeds.
HD-4: Geometry of W-G2 and W-N; whether a never-used WL89 V3 partition qualifies as W-H; commissioning the CK2 T1 reference.
HD-5: Restrict learned inputs to local frames and bounded receptive fields (no world coordinates, no scene-global pooling) for the ECRO lineage; E0 violates this.
HD-6: Whether to include the scale axis W-X; without it the cost-side H3 at N about 1,270 is bounded by measured Amdahl ceilings.
HD-7: Whether LLT runs at all, given that it infers footprint visibility between probes.
HD-8 (canon, outside this batch): whether an asset-level K owning exposed self-interreflection in a certified proxy should ever be considered (GM2).
HD-9: Batch class (regular vs suffix) and compute/server budget for any follow-up.
D1.verdict_rationale:
A primary candidate (XQT) and an independent alternative (LLT) have complete contracts. Both are measure-exact and passive by construction, linear, rigid-invariant and visibility-explicit (LLT only under a gate), and both carry the sharp, spatially distributed delivery in their learned part, with independent reference methods. The falsification plan separates H1, H2 and H3, keeps CK2 diagnostic, and lets a learning-free Stage 1 stop each candidate before any training.

The verdict carries three qualifications:
- **Proposition I [PRED].** In the GM1 surface regime, learning can add only estimation or amortization, not physical information.
- **Measured Amdahl ceilings [AUDIT D-04, D].** Even a zero-cost full operator reaches about 1.24–1.37 at the current scale, so cost-side utility is unlikely without quality-matched gains or a scale axis.
- **Flatland scratch.** Almost all of the pooling gain is available to the learning-free twin (oracle margin 1.0–1.33x in error).

I therefore predict that Stage 1 may end with no learned candidate in this regime. If the owner rules under HD-1 that an estimator-type operator is not the project's learned transport, the verdict becomes NO_DEFENSIBLE_CANDIDATE except for LLT, whose value depends on the S1-d information test. This is not adoption or experiment approval.

D2.role: D2 — independent designer, learning-and-generalization-first angle (WL98, design-only)
D2.summary:
D2's verdict is DESIGN_READY_FOR_HUMAN_REVIEW. It depends on human decisions HD2 (workload family / lineage), HD3 (an interface closure next to frozen ER) and HD7 (reference renderer). It does not adopt anything or approve any experiment.

WHY THE ECRO LINEAGE FAILED AS A LEARNED SYSTEM
- L1. It re-learned known physics: its learned S1 local factors approximate the frozen, exact ER, and failed at it [MEAS WL93D/J1; non-passive rows in 14 checkpoints].
- L2. Coverage was never designed. The operator is light-independent, so each incident column must be trained, but the columns were sampled only through random point lights. Grazing ring-0 occurs in 0.11 % of lightings, and allocation under the rank budget is zero-sum [AUDIT J1/J7].
- L3. Seed-signed errors (0.52x vs 1.63x) are what unconstrained extrapolation looks like.
- L4. Supervising only the sum of a product of learned factors is not identifiable.
- L5. Geometry conditioning bought little: 0.3-0.8 % of the error varied with geometry, while seed drift was 26-32 %.
- L6. Its same-state explicit twin was never beaten.
- L7. Evaluation could not separate H1 / H2 / H3.

PRINCIPLES (P1-P8)
A learned component must satisfy all of these; together they are the falsifiable core:
- P1: learn only what cannot be computed exactly at the target cost.
- P2: condition only on edit-invariant, object-local quantities.
- P3: train on impulses drawn from a declared measure, with a grazing quota.
- P4: train on unbiased physical event samples, never on M64.
- P5: get passivity from the output family itself.
- P6: give each learned component its own disjoint supervision.
- P7: name the learning-free twin and beat it.
- P8: use held-out factors.

STRUCTURAL FINDING [PRED, scoped; Stage G0 must measure it]
In the GM1 scene86 family every object is planar or convex and every surface is the pointwise ER closure, so intrinsic transport is exactly ER. That leaves three possible learned elements:
- a re-learned ER, which is excluded BRDF compression;
- a learned C, which WL52 measured to be slower than explicit GPU C;
- a geometry-conditioned resolvent.

Utility ceilings on the WL96A lifecycle [SCRATCH arithmetic on MEAS inputs]:
- tail only: 1.02 at zero learned cost, 0.92 at the measured learned cost;
- prefix + tail, which re-learns ER: 1.27 at zero cost, 1.12 at measured cost;
- only a role that also learns C exceeds 1.25 at measured cost (1.36).

So no candidate in that family meets the brief's suitability criteria.

SCRATCH EVIDENCE (CPU numpy)
- S1 ER lobe at grazing (half-max 4e-4 sr):
  - 4x16 solid-angle-mean bins: lobe L1 1.65, flux 1.46;
  - flux-conserving 32x128 bins: still 0.70;
  - adaptive quadtree: 0.11 at 1,024 leaves, 0.03 at 4,096 (adaptivity is learning-free);
  - generic Gaussian / Student-t lobe mixtures with K <= 4: 0.35-0.6 at grazing, but 0.04 at cos_i 0.8 with a single t lobe.
  - Conclusion: a lobe representation needs a structured family. For the sender, that family is ER itself.
- Toy slab: walks of 27-50 events per exit show no angular structure above the noise floor, while high-frequency exits occur only at 2-12 events. This is a real risk for intrinsic learned value.

CANDIDATES
- PRIMARY: LIEM-S. One shared net predicts a normalized sub-probability measure over (exit point, internal direction) for the collided intrinsic transport of a rigid medium domain with a rough dielectric interface.
  - The exact interface closure produces the sharp exit lobe.
  - Analytic anchors place displaced exits.
  - It is trained by event-likelihood on impulse random walks.
  - Rigid reuse is exact; C stays explicit.
  - Its value over three twins (explicit walk, analytic diffusion, per-asset table) is falsifiable.
- ALTERNATIVE: LIEM-B. It uses a hierarchical categorical exit distribution and is a representation-level alternative only. No mechanism-independent alternative survives.
- REJECTED:
  - ECRO-lineage A (continuous kernel), B (adaptive table; its learning-free version is kept as a control) and C (learned lobe);
  - rigid-cluster self-transport, which conflicts with canon;
  - learned sharp delivery.

PLAN
Two tracks that cannot share workloads:
- Track G (ECRO attribution): learning-free G0 first (admission, explicit frontier, ceilings with a stop rule), then G1 class floors, G2 coverage arms, G3 fixed-weight edits.
- Track I (LIEM): I0 (reference qualification, headroom admission, twin frontier), then I1 capacity, I2 learnability, I3 edits and economics with a kill rule.

All numerical thresholds are left as human decisions.

candidates.name: LIEM-S: Learned Intrinsic Exit Measure with structured lobes
candidates.family: other (intrinsic nonlocal K; angular type C, learned distribution, with exact interface closure)
candidates.learned_physical_meaning: The collided intrinsic transport kernel K^col of a rigid scattering-medium domain D bounded by a rough dielectric interface. K^col maps unit flux entering at (x_i, w_i) to outgoing radiance at the first exit (x_o, w_o) through internal paths with >=1 volume-scattering event (any number of internal reflections / TIR). It factorises as K^col = m_c(x_i,w_i) * Int p(x_o, nu | x_i, w_i) * BTDF(nu->w_o)/T(nu) dnu, where p is a learned probability density over the exit point on dD and the internal direction nu of the transmitting arrival, m_c in [0,1]^3 is the learned per-channel collided-exit probability, and the interface term is exact, not learned.
candidates.io: Input (all object-local): continuous entry point; entry direction in the local tangent frame; intrinsic features from D's own mesh (thickness along -n and along the refracted ray, distances to edges / corners within the support radius, curvature); medium descriptor z = (sigma_s, sigma_a per channel, g, eta, interface alpha) through a shared encoder. Output per query: per-channel mass; weights over spatial components anchored at analytic anchors (entry point, internal hit of the refracted entry ray, its first TIR continuation), each an anisotropic heavy-tailed 2D density in the anchor's tangent chart with per-channel width; per component, a mixture of internal-direction lobes in a bijective R^2 -> transmittable-cone chart, so there is no horizon truncation. The exit direction comes from the exact BTDF sample / evaluation.
candidates.ownership: Entry-point interface reflection: the local exact analytic GGX dielectric closure (not ER, not learned). Zero-collision ballistic internal transport: an explicit distinct path family (Architecture section 3; human decision HD4). All collided intrinsic transport, including its sharp low-order and through-object / TIR displacement: learned. All free space, including same-asset exit -> re-entry: explicit C on current geometry.
candidates.energy_contract: p is an exactly normalized density. Chart mass falling off the surface counts as absorption and is reported. m_c = sigmoid * (1 - m_bal), with the ballistic exit fraction m_bal computed explicitly. Total albedo <= rho_loc + (1 - rho_loc)(m_bal + m_c) <= 1 by construction. Composed K/C is sub-stochastic, so the spectral radius is < 1 whenever any loss exists [PRED, standard]. Reciprocity is a diagnostic only.
candidates.sharp_mechanism: (1) The exact rough-dielectric interface closure produces the sharp exit lobe per internal direction. (2) Learned internal-direction lobes can be arbitrarily narrow in a truncation-free cone chart. (3) Analytic anchors from intrinsic geometry place spatially displaced exits exactly. (4) Heavy-tailed spatial components carry the long tails. Scratch: generic lobe mixtures fail at horizon-truncated grazing lobes, which motivates the structure.
candidates.learned_vs_explicit_value: Twin-W (explicit internal random walk at runtime, unbiased, cost proportional to events per exit): learning must lower time-to-quality. Twin-D (learning-free shared analytic dipole / Burley-type rule + exact interface): learning must be more accurate near edges, thin parts, grazing and through-object transport. Twin-T (per-asset tabulated K from the same samples): learning must win on memory and angular / spatial error at matched samples and need no per-asset precompute on held-out shapes. If none of the three holds beyond paired tolerance on >=2 held-out workloads, learning is decorative. Toy-slab risk: long walks (27-50 events) show no angular structure, and high-frequency regimes have 2-12 events.
candidates.rationale: It is the only design satisfying P1-P8 together. Its learned object is rigid-invariant by construction, does not duplicate ER or C, has explicit twins with a cost scaling where learning can win, has designable coverage (directly addressing the ECRO H1 pathology) and is passive by construction. It addresses the fixed-basis angular limit of the learned-K lineage (WL57 16-in/64-out; WL58: 52-80 % loss at 256 bins, alpha 0.04). Conditional on HD2 / HD3 / HD7 / HD10: it sits outside the human-selected ECRO lineage in GM2-type workloads and in the learned-BSSRDF prior-art class, and must pass the I0.2 headroom gate.
candidates.complexity: One shared MLP (about 1e4-1e5 parameters [PRED]); per entry sample, one network evaluation + <=2 internal anchor ray casts against D's own mesh + one exact BTDF sample; per-asset intrinsic feature cache O(boundary samples); no per-asset operator table (Twin-T at CAK resolution is 2.0 GB per configuration [MEAS WL55]).
candidates.training_target: Impulse supervision from a declared measure mu_D: area-uniform entry with edge / corner / thin-region strata; cosine + uniform + a grazing quota (cos < 0.15) [HUM]; a descriptor prior; a procedural shape family with held-out shape classes. N_w float64 random walks per query with independent reference physics, cross-validated against the qualified reference. Loss: throughput-weighted NLL of exit events (x_o, nu) plus a binomial / MSE loss on the collided-exit fraction. No binned teacher; M64 never used.
candidates.rigid_reuse: Exact by construction. Inputs and outputs are object-local and mapped by the exact rigid transform; weights and the cached intrinsic features are reused. Tested to float tolerance, plus tessellation invariance. Non-rigid edits / contact invalidate D (certificate on foreign geometry within the support radius of dD) and fall back to Twin-W.
candidates.visibility_interface: None inside K. Exit radiance enters explicit C; no external geometry is an input. The I3 test moves only an occluder (C changes) and checks that K is untouched.
candidates.failure_conditions: GM1 surface-only scenes (degenerate: K = ER); smooth / delta interfaces; ballistic-dominated media (little to learn); dense diffusive media with a smooth response where Twin-D suffices; concave media with exits on disconnected regions not covered by anchors; thin features / edges (chart mass loss); heterogeneous media; non-rigid edits and contact; an unqualified refractive-media reference (Cycles validated only index-matched; Mitsuba float32 boundary layer).
candidates.why_not_brdf_compression: The learned object is a nonlocal boundary-to-boundary measure (exit position distributed over dD, through-object and TIR transport) with no pointwise closed form. The local interface response is exact and not learned.

candidates.name: LIEM-B: intrinsic sparse multi-resolution categorical exit distribution
candidates.family: other (intrinsic nonlocal K; angular type B, sparse multi-resolution)
candidates.learned_physical_meaning: The same collided intrinsic kernel K^col of a rigid medium domain, represented as a hierarchical categorical distribution over exit cell on dD x exit-direction cell (equal-area hierarchy, flux-conserving cos convention), plus a NULL / absorption category.
candidates.io: Input: the same object-local entry features and descriptor. Output: coarse-to-fine hierarchical softmax with refinement, giving a sparse set of k (cell, direction-cell) coefficients up to level L, plus mass.
candidates.ownership: Same as LIEM-S: local interface exact, ballistic explicit, collided learned, free space explicit C.
candidates.energy_contract: Softmax-with-NULL gives column sums <= 1, so the deterministic linear operator is passive by construction. Hemisphere cells are exact, so there is no horizon truncation.
candidates.sharp_mechanism: Adaptive refinement depth; scratch flux-conserving quadtree about 0.1 lobe L1 at about 1,000 leaves on the grazing S1 lobe vs 0.70 for fixed 32x128. It does not use the exact interface closure for exit directions (a variant could), so interface sharpness must be resolved by cells. Within-cell smearing keeps J2's receiver-dependent sign below the finest level.
candidates.learned_vs_explicit_value: Same twins as LIEM-S. Twin-T is exactly the same hierarchy filled by explicit per-asset counts. Learning buys generalisation without per-asset tables, and memory.
candidates.rationale: Representation-level alternative only, NOT mechanism-independent: it shares ownership, data and workload, and therefore most failure causes, with LIEM-S. It is kept because it is the deterministic linear-operator form compatible with FNTO's F/S state-solve contract and the natural H2 control (adaptive discrete vs continuous structured). No mechanism-independent alternative survived.
candidates.complexity: Sparse gather / scatter of k coefficients per entry sample; inference and output size grow with k and L; per-asset tabulation reproduces Twin-T.
candidates.training_target: Multinomial likelihood of the same physically sampled exit events, binned hierarchically (unbiased counts, no regression on noisy bins).
candidates.rigid_reuse: Exact (object-local), as LIEM-S.
candidates.failure_conditions: Those of LIEM-S, plus sub-cell lobes below level L and large categorical output spaces (higher H1 / learnability risk).
candidates.why_not_brdf_compression: Nonlocal boundary-to-boundary measure, as LIEM-S.

candidates.name: R-A: ECRO-lineage continuous directional learned kernel
candidates.learned_physical_meaning: b_>=2(x,w) = Int K_theta(x,w <- y,w'; G) s(y,w'): a geometry-conditioned linear kernel from the direct incident field to the >=2-event outgoing radiance, queried at continuous points and directions (ECRO's B table replaced by a neural field linear in s).
candidates.io: Input: scene geometry tokens + ER states + relations, the source encoding, and a query (x, w). Output: RGB radiance.
candidates.ownership: It owns compositions ER o C o ER..., so its learned content is an amortised scene-level resolvent with no intrinsic/C split inside it.
candidates.energy_contract: Undefined for a free continuous kernel: passivity requires integrating K_theta over w, which is not closed form (unsuitability criterion 5).
candidates.sharp_mechanism: Continuous w removes readout bin bias. Sharp delivery (glint onto diffuse receivers) remains a C property the kernel must learn.
candidates.learned_vs_explicit_value: Twin = EXP/C3URX1 (exact ER, explicit relations, exact reads; pooled = oracle) or sender-anchored splat. Only amortised variance / cost is learning-specific. Utility ceiling at the measured learned cost <= 1.12 for any role that does not learn C (scratch on the WL96A lifecycle).
candidates.rationale: Unsuitability criteria 1 (it replaces explicit transport only by re-learning ER or learning C), 3 (learned flights couple dynamic visibility) and 5 (energy undefined). It also inherits the light-sampled coverage pathology. Scoped to scene86/GM1 and the N 1,270 prototype; it can be reopened only if learning-free Stage G0 measures a ceiling >= U_min [HUM].
candidates.rigid_reuse: Weights only; all state is regenerated after any edit; no exact equivariance (world-frame conditioning).
candidates.visibility_interface: Either through explicit relations (inherits 0.46 rays-per-draw glint variance and re-learns ER at the sender) or learned (learned C).
candidates.failure_conditions: Under-covered grazing incidences; geometry outside the training family (WL93D: the model ignores geometry).
candidates.why_not_brdf_compression: It is not BRDF compression, but it is a learned C / resolvent, which fails other criteria.

candidates.name: R-B: ECRO-lineage sparse multi-resolution angular table
candidates.learned_physical_meaning: ECRO's table B[patch, angular cell] with an adaptive flux-conserving hierarchical angular basis per patch, coefficients from the ECRO generator.
candidates.io: As ECRO, with a sparse variable-length output per patch.
candidates.ownership: As ECRO (>=3-event paths).
candidates.energy_contract: Flux-conserving cells give per-bin flux exactness. Operator passivity is not guaranteed (learned factors have non-passive rows, J1).
candidates.sharp_mechanism: Adaptive refinement.
candidates.learned_vs_explicit_value: The angular gain is fully available learning-free: an explicit quadtree reaches about 0.1 lobe L1 at about 1,000 leaves [SCRATCH], and J2 measured 8x32 within 2-6 % at box-A delivery. Learning adds only the failing ECRO operator.
candidates.rationale: The representation fix is not learning-specific (P7). It is retained as the learning-free flux-corrected / high-resolution / adaptive binned control arm (E-cos64 / E-cos256 / E-QT) in Track G.
candidates.rigid_reuse: Weights only.
candidates.failure_conditions: As ECRO.
candidates.why_not_brdf_compression: Not compression; the learned part is the ECRO operator.

candidates.name: R-C: ECRO-lineage learned directional lobe / distribution at patches
candidates.learned_physical_meaning: Per-patch once-scattered sender radiance, or >=2-event outgoing radiance, as learned lobe parameters generated from geometry and source.
candidates.io: Patch / source encoding -> K lobes per patch.
candidates.ownership: For the sender, the exact lobe family is ER itself (7 GGX + Lambert), so learning it is BRDF compression. For >=2-event glossy outgoing radiance (= ER x incident field), the learned part is the incident field, i.e. C.
candidates.energy_contract: Normalized lobes x mass <= 1 are possible (its one advantage).
candidates.sharp_mechanism: Lobe width. Scratch: generic Gaussian / t mixtures (K<=4) reach only 0.35-0.6 lobe L1 at grazing, with 2-7x peak overshoot (0.04 at cos_i 0.8).
candidates.learned_vs_explicit_value: Twin = exact ER evaluation, better by construction.
candidates.rationale: Brief exclusion (mere BRDF compression), P1 violation, and scratch capacity evidence at grazing incidence.
candidates.rigid_reuse: Weights only.
candidates.failure_conditions: Grazing, horizon-truncated multi-lobe responses.
candidates.why_not_brdf_compression: It IS local BRDF compression for the sender, so it is excluded.

candidates.name: R-D: rigid-cluster certified self-transport (RCT)
candidates.learned_physical_meaning: For a rigid multi-surface asset, a learned operator owning all self-interreflection paths within its certified region, reused under the asset's rigid motion while no foreign geometry intrudes.
candidates.io: The asset's local incident field -> local outgoing field after self-paths.
candidates.ownership: Owns exposed same-asset free-space paths. This conflicts with Architecture section 2 ('Object identity must not freeze exposed interreflection or merge editable air transport into K').
candidates.energy_contract: Sub-stochastic if built from normalized measures.
candidates.sharp_mechanism: As LIEM-S, with ER at every bounce.
candidates.learned_vs_explicit_value: Twin = cached explicit relations within the asset, equally rigid-invariant and reusable, so learning buys only sweep amortisation (small per WL96A) and continuity. Per-asset training puts it in the external 8DNA-like Native Reuse class.
candidates.rationale: Canon conflict plus weak learned value; scene86 has no concave asset. Only the user can reopen the ownership question (HD5).
candidates.rigid_reuse: Exact under the asset's own motion, with an intrusion certificate.
candidates.visibility_interface: Intrusion certificate -> fallback to explicit C inside the region; partial intrusion cannot be subtracted.
candidates.failure_conditions: Partial intrusion; shape generalisation of surface self-transport (= learned C).
candidates.why_not_brdf_compression: Nonlocal, but conflicts with ownership canon.

candidates.name: R-E: learned sharp delivery / learned C for sharp senders
candidates.learned_physical_meaning: Learned prediction of the irradiance delivered by sharp sender lobes onto receivers, conditioned on current geometry.
candidates.io: Sender lobe + geometry -> receiver irradiance.
candidates.ownership: C (free space).
candidates.energy_contract: Normalizable (pi-softmax-with-NULL as in WL52).
candidates.sharp_mechanism: Must learn beam visibility.
candidates.learned_vs_explicit_value: Sender-anchored lobe splatting (ER sample + ray cast) resolves the glint that receiver-anchored gathering misses (0.46 rays per draw, WL96); its cost is unmeasured. Learned visibility cannot beat hardware ray casting on accuracy [PRED]. WL52 learned C was slower than explicit GPU C (C path 0.18x speed, update 8-19x slower) and failed contact / transition locality.
candidates.rationale: Unsuitability criteria 1 and 3 and P1. The explicit splat twin enters Track G as frontier arm E-SPL.
candidates.rigid_reuse: No: depends on relative poses.
candidates.failure_conditions: Contacts and visibility transitions (WL52).
candidates.why_not_brdf_compression: Not compression; it is learned C.

D2.falsification_plan:
Two tracks that cannot share workloads, training data or references. Every stage order, gate and stop rule is declared before results; numerical thresholds are human decisions.

TRACK G: ECRO-lineage attribution on the GM1 scene86 family (H1 / H2 / H3 of the historical failure; not an adoption track)
- G0, learning-free:
  - G0.1 Admission:
    - E2 (the WL86 failure);
    - E5 (the qualified held-out);
    - one NEW geometry-chosen, radiance-uninspected, margin-disjoint held-out workload with a grazing sharp component and a T0->T1 rigid edit with a path-traced T1 reference, admitted on a qualification partition (change SNR >= 4, sharp-change share, reference noise bound);
    - CK2 is diagnostic only and never decides a gate.
    - Stop: STOPPED_UNQUALIFIED_WORKLOAD.
  - G0.2 Explicit quality-cost frontier, with frozen ER and shared references and state draws:
    - arms E-sa64 (= EXP), E-cos64, E-cos256 (8x32), E-QT (adaptive quadtree), E-X1 at 1x / 4x / 16x draws, E-SPL (sender-anchored splat);
    - outputs: sharp-ROI E_H, region C, changed-region fidelity, extra T1-T0 error, leakage / ghosting, lifecycle cost.
  - G0.3 Ceilings: zero-cost and measured-learned-cost utility ceilings per learnable role (resolvent; prefix+tail; +relation), against the quality-matched explicit point, at N {1,270, ~5k, ~11k}, J {1, 4}, frame on / off.
  - STOP: if no role that does not learn C reaches U_min on >= 2 admitted workloads, then H3 holds at ceiling level and no ECRO-lineage training runs for architecture purposes (attribution training only by HD8).
- G1, H2 capacity with no learning: class floors against the path-traced reference (never M64):
  - the delivery-optimal patch x 64-bin operator (sa and cos conventions);
  - admissible non-negative rank-16/32 operators under declared incidence weights;
  - 8x32 and quadtree floors.
- G2, H1 learnability (only if G0 passes or HD8). Arms share data, budget, references and >= 3 seeds:
  - F-ECRO (frozen);
  - ECRO-R (fresh-seed retrain);
  - ECRO-COV (designed per-(patch, ring) coverage floor, including ring 0, plus path-traced q supervision of the once-scattered stage);
  - ECRO-COV-FC (+ flux-conserving or 8x32 output).
  - Readings:
    - H1 if COV closes >= X % of ECRO-R's gap to the class floor on grazing sharp regions in every seed without non-grazing regression;
    - H2 if the class floor misses the target and FC lowers it;
    - H3 if the best arm's utility < U_min against the quality-matched explicit frontier.
- G3, fixed-weight edits on admitted held-outs: STALE control, signed-change slope / corr, extra T1-T0 error, leakage, paired against the explicit arms at matched cost.

TRACK I: LIEM candidate
- I0:
  - I0.1 Reference qualification for refractive-interface media.
    - Candidates: Cycles volume + rough glass, or Mitsuba on LabServer69 with the float32 boundary layer bounded.
    - Checks: an independent float64 random walk and analytic controls (index-matched furnace, Fresnel-boundary slab by adding-doubling, reciprocity, superposition).
    - Stop: STOPPED_REFERENCE_UNQUALIFIED.
  - I0.2 Headroom admission. A configuration is admitted only if:
    - (a) collided share >= s_min;
    - (b) events per collided exit >= e_min;
    - (c) angular high-frequency content (best flux-conserving 16-in/64-out projection loss) >= h_min above the matched MC noise floor;
    - (d) change SNR >= 4;
    - (e) both grazing and non-grazing incidence are present.
    - Template: the scene86 room with frozen-ER sharp panel / floor / sphere, plus movable medium object(s) and a Lambert occluder.
    - Plus >= 1 independent held-out workload (unseen shape class and light set).
    - STOP_NO_HEADROOM if no configuration meets (b) and (c) together.
  - I0.3 Twin frontier: Twin-W time-to-error, Twin-D error, Twin-T error by memory.
- I1, H2 capacity: per-query oracle fits on the synthetic contract set (slabs, edges, corners, wedges; grazing / non-grazing strata) for LIEM-S, LIEM-B, the WL57 16/64 basis and the WL58 64/256 basis. STOP_H2 if the LIEM-S floor (then the LIEM-B floor) misses the target on more than a declared share of strata.
- I2, H1 learnability. Shared generator, budget and >= 3 seeds:
  - LIEM-S on mu_D (designed, with grazing quota);
  - LIEM-S on mu_S (scene-induced, ECRO-style uncontrolled coverage);
  - the WL57 decoder on mu_D (existing representation + improved coverage);
  - LIEM-B on mu_D;
  - evaluated on held-out entries, shapes and descriptors.
  - Readings: H1 if mu_S - floor >> mu_D - floor on grazing strata; learnability failure if mu_D - floor stays large.
- I3, H3 utility with fixed weights, T0->T1:
  - (i) a rigid move of the medium object;
  - (ii) an occluder-only move (C changes, K must be untouched).
  - Arms: LIEM-S, LIEM-B, Twin-W, Twin-D, Twin-T, STALE, ballistic variants — all with identical explicit C and frozen ER.
  - Image evidence: error vs reference, sharp-interreflection ROI, changed-region fidelity, leakage / ghosting, extra T1-T0 error.
  - System evidence: edit-to-valid-frame critical path, steady frame, learned inference, relation recompute, memory and precompute, utility against the quality-matched best twin.
  - KILL: LIEM beats no twin (time-to-quality vs W, accuracy vs D, memory without precompute vs T) beyond paired tolerance on >= 2 held-out workloads.
  - External baselines: 8DNA Native Reuse is optional (HD9); Neural Full Recompute is UNMEASURED unless aligned; path tracing is reference / re-render cost only.

STATISTICS (both tracks)
- Paired on identical references, cameras, state draws and seeds.
- Split-half references for debiased error.
- Block-bootstrap SE; paired tolerance = max(2 SE, M_min). A noise floor is never used as a paired tolerance.
- >= 3 seeds per learned arm; >= 16 state draws for any relation-sampled arm; no label decided by one draw.
- Per-geometry tables and median-of-means as heavy-tail guards.
- Train / validation / test split by shape class, descriptor range, workload and edit before results.

SYNTHETIC vs REAL-SCENE
Synthetic contract tests (exact equivariance, tessellation invariance, normalization, linearity, analytic slabs, stratified impulse fidelity) isolate representation (I1) and learnability (I2). Real-scene evaluation is the only place where coverage mismatch, K/C composition, readout and cost appear. Neither approves anything alone.
human_decisions: HD1: Accept or reject D2's scoped design finding that no learned candidate in the GM1 scene86 surface-only family meets the brief's suitability criteria, or require Track G0 (learning-free ceilings and explicit frontier) to measure it first.

HD2: Whether the learned-transport hypothesis may be tested on workloads with nonlocal intrinsic transport (rough-dielectric scattering media; GM2 territory, FNTO learned-K lineage) instead of, or alongside, the ECRO lineage chosen as central on 2026-11-13. The workload template keeps GM1's sharp ER panel.
HD3: Whether an analytic rough-dielectric interface closure may be introduced next to the frozen WL84 ER. This adds a closure; it does not modify ER.
HD4: Ballistic (zero-collision) family ownership for LIEM: explicit (canonical, Architecture section 3) or learned.
HD5: Whether rigid-cluster self-transport ownership (R-D) may ever be considered; it is rejected under the current canon.

HD6: All numerical thresholds: U_min utility ratio, M_min minimum meaningful paired effect, reference tolerances, admission thresholds s_min / e_min / h_min, grazing quota of mu_D, per-cell coverage floor for ECRO-COV, H1 gap-closure fraction X, I1 stop share, number of seeds (>= 3 proposed) and of state draws (>= 16 proposed).
HD7: Reference renderer for mixed ER + medium scenes (Cycles volume + rough glass vs Mitsuba on LabServer69) and the admissible medium density range given the Mitsuba float32 boundary-layer bias.
HD8: Whether Track G training arms (G1/G2) run for attribution even if G0 closes the ECRO lineage for architecture purposes.
HD9: External baselines on the medium workload: whether to set up 8DNA Native Reuse; Neural Full Recompute is declared UNMEASURED unless an invalidated external representation can be aligned.

HD10: Novelty acceptance: LIEM sits in the learned-BSSRDF prior-art class [LIT-unverified: Vicini, Koltun, Jakob 2019]. The novelty discipline requires joint ownership, edit-validity and economics evidence.
HD11: Compute budget and main-server choice for both tracks.
stop_conditions_triggered: None of the batch's stop conditions fired. Design-level scoped finding [PRED, not measured]: inside the GM1 scene86 surface-only family no learned candidate meets the brief's suitability criteria. Every learned element there is a re-learned ER, a learned C or a resolvent whose utility ceiling at the measured learned cost is <= 1.12 (scratch arithmetic on WL96A/WL86 inputs). Stage G0 must measure this before it is used as a premise.

Scratch risk flag (not a stop): on a toy slab, long internal walks (27-50 events per exit) show no exit angular structure above the noise floor, while high-frequency exits occur only at 2-12 events. LIEM therefore carries a predeclared STOP_NO_HEADROOM gate (I0.2) before any training.
